scripts.install-all: npm install && npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix server
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix frontend && npm run prisma:generate --prefix server
scripts.check:syntax: node --check server.js && node --check backend/routes/auth.js && node --check backend/models/User.js
scripts.validate: npm run check:syntax && npx prisma validate --schema=server/prisma/schema.prisma && npm run build
